2609.24932.title: Linguistic Features for Interpretable Textual Entailment
2609.24932.paper_summary: Despite the success of neural models in natural language processing, their black-box nature limits interpretability and conceals the linguistic phenomena underlying their predictions. We present SLITE, an explainable hybrid model for Recognizing Textual Entailment that integrates two complementary layers of semantic analysis: a structural-relational layer, based on semantic compatibility and incompatibility between compositional entities, and a distributional-informational layer, based on structured patterns of information change between embedding-based representations of the premise and the hypothesis. We propose 17 features that combine entity-level semantic relations, polarity-sensitive lexical matching, and alignment measures over semantic sub-representations of the similarity matrix, including measures based on entropy and transfer entropy. A logistic regression trained on these features achieves an accuracy of 83% on three-class SICK and 96% on SICK-CE, outperforming IsoLex by 4 percentage points and falling within 2 percentage points of RoBERTa with a fraction of its computational complexity. Ablation studies and SHAP analysis confirm that structural-relational features are the primary drivers of classification, while distributional-informational features provide essential complementary contributions, particularly for detecting neutrality and contradiction. Our results demonstrate that further exploration of hybrid approaches is a viable and scientifically productive alternative to massive neural architectures, and we hope they will strengthen the dialogue between linguistic theory and computational modeling of inference
2609.24932.paper_summary_zh: 儘管神經模型在自然語言處理中取得了成功，但其黑箱特性限制了可解釋性，並隱藏了其預測背後的語言現象。我們提出了SLITE，一種可解釋的混合模型，用於識別文本蕴涵，該模型整合了兩個互補的語義分析層：基於組合實體之間語義相容性和不相容性的結構-關係層，以及基於前提和假設的嵌入表示之間信息變化的結構模式的分佈-信息層。我們提出了17個特徵，結合了實體級語義關係、極性敏感的詞彙匹配和語義子表示的相似性矩陣上的對齊度量，包括基於熵和轉移熵的度量。基於這些特徵訓練的邏輯回歸在三類SICK上達到83%的準確率，在SICK-CE上達到96%，比IsoLex高出4個百分點，並且在計算複雜度上僅為RoBERTa的一小部分。消融研究和SHAP分析確認結構-關係特徵是分類的主要驅動因素，而分佈-信息特徵則提供了重要的互補貢獻，特別是在檢測中立性和矛盾方面。我們的結果表明，進一步探索混合方法是一種可行且科學上富有成效的替代方案，對於龐大的神經架構，我們希望這能加強語言理論與推理計算建模之間的對話。
